text:
alex: Kicking off the SparkFlow micro-experiment. Tiny PLG bundle: 120 starter tokens + 4 curated prompt templates + 22-min product walkthrough webinar. Hypothesis: bundling templates + live demo will lift day7 retention by ~9%. Need routing snippet and two messaging angles today. :sparkles:

nina: Love it. Tentative webinar next Wed 11am PT. I'll draft landing + 3 subject lines and 2 CTAs.

owen: Suggest traffic split 60% tokens-only, 40% tokens+templates+webinar. Keep cohort sizes even-ish. We should tag experiment_id on events.

tasha: Ops: reserve capacity for ~180 concurrent viewers, fallback recording embed if >250. ops-bot, can you pre-provision an extra node group?

ops-bot: autoscale template queued. Reserving a spare group for day-of. Confirm final peak by EOD. :gear:

priya: Routing pseudo (minimal, keep product-safe):
```
segment: new_users_0-4d
trigger: first_success_call
actions:
  - grant_starter_tokens: 120
  - attach_promptpack: sparkflow-starters-v1
  - schedule_webinar_invite: +24h
metrics: calls_48h, promptpack_use_pct, day7_retention
experiment_tag: sparkflow_q2_2026
```
Make sure events include experiment_tag for filtering.

alex: Messaging axes: A) "Ship AI features fast with 4 ready templates" B) "Join a 22-min demo + get templates". We'll A/B subject line + hero CTA. Keep copy punchy.

growth-bot: Baseline pulled: cohort day7 retention = 17.9%, avg tokens first week = 2.45k, est unit cost per activation = $6.10. CSV uploaded to #marketing-assets/sparkflow_baseline.csv.

own: Measurement: primary = day7 retention lift; secondary = promptpack reuse (3+ calls) and webinar watch-rate. Need a Console dashboard named "sparkflow_experiment". Can someone spin it up?

sam (typo): sam not in channel — meant owen.

own: also ask analytics to include cost-per-retained-user calc using token burn + med token price.

nina: CS follow-up plan: 2-email drip for webinar attendees with 3 copyable prompts and a short case snippet. Also an in-product nudge for prompt reuse.

tasha: Action items:
- @nina: landing + subject lines + CTAs (EOD)
- @priya: implement routing + add experiment_tag (tomorrow AM)
- @ops-bot: confirm reserve capacity + autoscale (today)
- @growth-bot: refresh baseline after seed launch and attach run CSVs

alex: Quick check: starter token amount 120 ok? If anyone wants split test token amounts (e.g., 60 vs 120) propose now, but prefer uniform for clarity.

nina: 120 works. Splitting would complicate analysis for this first run.

alex: OK proceeding uniform. I'll post a one-pager for execs after dashboards are live. :white_check_mark:
